Hourly air-quality sensor data from a US city, found while searching for more hourly data.

The first pass was right that 647i-nhxk holds only "nel mese in corso" (the current month). But the same ARPA Lombardia story page that the search pointed to lists historical datasets. "Temperatura fino al 2010" is described as air temperature from the ARPA Lombardia network "fino al 31 dicembre 2010", with licence CC0 1.0, attribution "ARPA Lombardia", times in "ora solare", and columns idsensore/data/valore/stato. Small queries show it runs 1987-11-25 to 2011-01-01, with 178 sensors reporting between 2004-03-10 and 2005-04-04, at half-hourly steps for the sensor I checked and flagged "VA". So it gives real station observations for the prototype window. Caveats: the client's region is not stated and Lombardy may not be it, so this checks reanalysis bias for northern Italy, not for the client's own site. Humidity is a separate dataset on the same host ("Umidità relativa fino al 2010", nure-mhrg, CC0, 77 sensors in the window), and the station list is nf78-nj6b. Use is prototyping/benchmark only, which the register policy allows.
